description: Four predominant beta-thalassemia mutations commonly screened in the Indian subcontinent, curated with verified RefSeq genomic/cDNA coordinates and ClinVar variation IDs.

mutations.mechanism: Mutates the +5 consensus nucleotide of the donor 5' splice site of intron 1, reducing normal splicing efficiency and activating cryptic splice sites.
mutations.guide_coordinate_note: The educational guide noted position ~30601 from an older/arbitrary cluster indexing; the official RefSeq NG_000007.3 coordinate is 70691 (relative gene position 147).

mutations.mechanism: 4-base pair deletion in exon 2 causing a translational reading frameshift at phenylalanine 42, leading to premature termination and complete loss of beta-globin production.
mutations.guide_coordinate_note: Educational guide noted position ~30561; RefSeq NG_000007.3 genomic coordinate is 70850 (cDNA 126..129, gene relative 306).

mutations.mechanism: Insertion of a single guanine nucleotide in codons 8/9 causing a translational reading frameshift at serine 10 with premature termination.
mutations.guide_coordinate_note: The educational guide contained a typographical error labeling this 'Exon 3'. In human HBB, codons 8 and 9 reside unambiguously in Exon 1 (codons 1-30). Educational guide noted position ~30632; RefSeq NG_000007.3 coordinate is 70621 (cDNA position 27, gene relative 77).

mutations.mechanism: Substitution at the final nucleotide of exon 1 (c.93G>C) causing amino acid change p.Arg31Ser and severely impairing normal splicing recognition at the exon 1 / intron 1 junction.
mutations.guide_coordinate_note: Educational guide noted position ~30587; RefSeq NG_000007.3 coordinate is 70686 (last nucleotide of Exon 1, cDNA position 93, gene relative 142).
